<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby>、<ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>初<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>贴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>框<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>松<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby>做<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>叠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>扇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>叠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby>、<ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>初<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>金<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>贴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiē</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">záo</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>筑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby> <ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>弗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>布<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>八<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>属<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>宫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>室<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>；

verses.text: <ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>建<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>黎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lí</rt></ruby><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>嫩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèn</rt></ruby><ruby>林<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>宫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby>（<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>柁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>梁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>香<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>框<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>：<ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>斤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby></mark>；<ruby>左<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>波<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bō</rt></ruby><ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ā</rt></ruby><ruby>斯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby></mark>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>顶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>毕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>铸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>式<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>圆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>径<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>驮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuó</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby>：<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>尾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wěi</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>花<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>容<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>罢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bà</rt></ruby><ruby>特<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>盆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pén</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>条<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiáo</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>驴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǘ</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>驴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǘ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>橡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>嘱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。’”<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>诓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby>。

二<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>违<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>背<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>令<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby>，
